fan_question: Is Real Madrid's perfect Champions League run for real?

beats.say: Real Madrid had twenty-four shots to nine. And still trailed with fifteen to go.
Forty-four touches in their box to fourteen. Seven corners to none.
Then Valverde, off the bench on sixty-seven, wins it in stoppage time. Nought point oh three expected goals.
